messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands in profile, then raises both arms overhead, turns, and lowers the arms back to a standing pose.","camera":"Static medium-wide shot at roughly waist-to-head height, keeping the figure centered against the storefront.","clothing":"Yellow long-sleeved shirt with a white floral pattern, red-and-black plaid trousers, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a high ponytail.","identity":"A slim person with dark skin, shown in profile and then from the back, with a short face and visible ear.","scene":"A rendered old-town street with a stone sidewalk, a dark shopfront with red curtains, and signs reading 'SOAP', 'COCOA POWDER', and 'FROM THE COUNTRYSIDE'."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a fairground pavilion and food carts to the reference old-town storefront with stone sidewalk, dark shopfront, red curtains, and SOAP/COCOA POWDER signs. The person remains in a similar profile position and performs the same arm-raising turn and return to standing. The trousers now appear red-and-black plaid rather than the darker plaid in the source, and the lighting is brighter and more neutral than the source sunset.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source amusement-park scene with the reference storefront environment while preserving the same person, blue ponytail, yellow floral shirt, plaid trousers, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, with natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the person's facial expression was preserved exactly, since the face is mostly in profile and small in frame.
unexpected_changes: The trousers changed from dark plaid in the source to clearly red-and-black plaid in the output.
